children: Romania's finance ministry aims to sell domestic treasury bonds and bills worth 7.2 billion lei ($1.59 billion) in September, and an additional 15% worth of the issued paper through non-competitive tenders, it said on Monday.
Romania has sold roughly 68.8 billion lei and 1.7 billion euros at domestic tenders so far this year. It tapped foreign markets for 3 billion euros and $2 billion.
